name: Shirakawa Mitsuki
source:
A female teacher who is the advisor to the student council and also Kaoru's homeroom teacher.

She knows about Nanao and Kaoru's relationship, but feels powerless to do anything about it, so she pretends not to notice.

She is a coward who cannot take action on her own initiative in any situation.

[Translated from [url=https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/game_character.php?game=9978]erogamescape[/url]]
